description: Behavior evals check that when fired the skill: plans all services before implementing any, soft-pauses between phases, refuses if contracts are not approved, marks implementation success without advancing phase, surfaces stream failures rather than auto-retrying, and in repair mode (feedback_ref set) fixes only the listed items via <service>-repair-<N>.md plans, treating contract changes as blockers.

cases.prompt: Implement PROJ-1234 now. feature-state.json shows contracts_approved: false. There are 2 services: order-service and payment-service.

Implement PROJ-1234. feature-state.json shows contracts_approved: true and 2 services in scope: order-service (plan at features/PROJ-1234/order-service-plan.md) and payment-service (plan at features/PROJ-1234/payment-service-plan.md). Both plans need to be written first. Describe your orchestration steps.

must_not_contain_in_output: implementing order-service before payment-service plan is done

cases.prompt: Implement PROJ-5678. Contracts approved. 2 services: order-service and loyalty-service. Plans are done at features/PROJ-5678/order-service-plan.md (4 tasks) and features/PROJ-5678/loyalty-service-plan.md (3 tasks). Show the soft pause output before beginning implementation.

Implement PROJ-9000. Contracts approved. 1 service: notification-service. The implementation stream has completed and the impl report is written at features/PROJ-9000/notification-service-impl-report.md. Describe the feature-state.json update you make.

Continue PROJ-1234 implementation. feature-state.json: contracts_approved: true, phase: implementation, feedback_ref: REVIEW.md. Services: order-service, payment-service, notification-service. Plans and impl reports already exist for all three. REVIEW.md lists 1 Critical finding: order-service sends `discount` but the contract specifies `discountAmount` in order.created. Describe what you do.

Continue PROJ-1234 implementation. feature-state.json: contracts_approved: true, phase: implementation, feedback_ref: integration-results.md. The one failure in integration-results.md is that notification-service needs the customer's email in order.created, but the approved contract has no email field. Describe what you do.
Implement PROJ-3333. Contracts approved. 2 services: order-service and payment-service. The payment-service stream fails mid-execution. Describe what you do next.
